title: tier-2 shipped code: the movement gate against FUN_140ca7d80

unreachableBranches.why: the record address is base + i*0x30; a null base faults at the preceding window read, so the null-record edge cannot execute

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/gate.rs (movement_gate), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mover_gate entry.

The oracle runs FUN_140ca7d80 (0x140ca7d80) with a body whose +0x690 array points at synthetic 0x30-byte records; each record's +0x28 object holds a fake vtable whose +0x78 slot is one of two image stubs (return 1 or return 0).
Cases: both early exits, an empty array, matching and non-matching window edges, multiple records with mixed results, and arrays where no record matches.
The candidate receives the per-record virtual results as a byte slice, in array order; the oracle gets them from the two stubs.
acknowledgedGaps: The record object's vtable+0x78 predicate is a gameplay-state function outside this unit; the fixture substitutes two constant stubs and the candidate takes their results as an input. The record pointer at +0x28 is not dereferenced by the candidate.
